decisions.pick: One lord per squad: A Theodora, B Cai now; C Leda, D Dietrich, E Talimun as squads open
decisions.why: A lord's map ability works only in its squad. Theodora (battalions) and Cai (Farming) farm in different regions, and each lord's own army already has its supports and Dance targets.
decisions.alt: Role squads with the lords as guests (D-131 #4)

decisions.pick: Theodora's War army takes Breza and Shenlo; the imports level on the bench
decisions.why: Dietrich's, Cai's and Leda's armies skipped Part II and arrive auto-leveled. Theodora's 15 played all six War maps. Bench units gain EXP every map turn.

decisions.pick: Recruit the copy that played Part II (Theodora's), else the one that deployed most in Part I
decisions.why: More levels, ranks and masteries. Merges keep the best stat of each copy, so the base copy only decides class and kit.
decisions.alt: Free re-clear merges (replaying Part I and II)

decisions.pick: Balor 24 first: Sirocco, Olympia, Catania, Guzran, Ninae (1,500 Karma Shards); the other four only with spare shards
decisions.why: A merge only pays on a unit that fights to the end, and most where the copies took different classes. Sirocco's ranks also decide The Avatar's exam. Merges come before Drifting Reliquary relics (500 to 1,000 each).

decisions.pick: Merges 1–5 (1,500) → Boon buys (decision below) → skill-EXP Boons for Divine S gaps → Rich Deposits → Discounts → merges 6–9
decisions.why: Skill Boons (300 each) count in battle only, so they push Cai's Axe, Tobias's and Nuzzuo's Sword S in fights. Weapons come from Boons or the Reliquary (player, Oct 16): only the few that beat gold picks.

decisions.pick: Arena and Inn materials → the next gate's Licenses → Arena II → other Licenses (squads D and E last) → Elixirs → Anna's boosters
decisions.why: Licenses are 8,000G and 3 a Section at the vendor; quests pay about 163,000G against 288,000G of planned Licenses. Arena II returns 30,000G; boosters (14,000G each) come last.

decisions.pick: Cai Black Horse · Alexandra Falicorn · Lysander Red Bau · Seteth Black Bau · Hong Hua Monoceros · Gaitz Saramis War Elephant
decisions.why: The Stable serves every army now. Bond 5 adds up to +3 to a stat and +15% growth, and Canto lets strikers hit and step back. Benched riders' mounts move to squad riders; the quest elephants go to Gaitz and maybe Ultand.

decisions.pick: Next gate's deploy first, then the Balor 24, then everyone else; Divine-bound units after units that keep the Master class
decisions.why: Only 3 Licenses a Section at the Dagsion vendor (8,000G), more in repaired markets. A Master class kept to 6/6 pays longest; one held for a Section or two before a Divine exam pays least. Nuzzuo skips Bow Knight.
decisions.alt: Licenses in roster order; Nuzzuo's one-Section Bow Knight stint

decisions.pick: Arena 3 → Inn 2 → Arena II 20 by the end of Section 3 → Aiding in Prayer 7 → Inn II 5 (37)
decisions.why: Arena II's stronger training feeds the Divine S ranks before the Section 4 exams and pays 30,000G back; Prayer (stronger Service) only has to land before Section 5's gates.
decisions.alt: Prayer before Arena II; Inn first

decisions.pick: Teach Hidden Evilbreak with Answerer's Cry shards: Tobias by Breza (Section 2), Troy next, Mu by Section 4
decisions.why: Gauntlet art: on hit it strips the Underworld Boon through the foe's next combat. Tobias fights Breza and Shenlo, both undead. Dietrich rides in A until Section 4 to farm shards.

decisions.pick: Silver Axe +2 Mikaela · Sinza's Trident Esmeralda (if no copy) · Silver Spear +2 Seteth · Gale Ring Alexandra, Troy, Seteth · Photona's Holy Staff Dante
decisions.why: Only picks more than ~2 damage or 5 Hit over the gold option (D-157). After merges 1–5. Lilian's Silver Bow only if no copy (Da Mina Bow +2 is 1 Mt less). Bench last: Dadao, Jasmine, Aswan, Klapka.
decisions.alt: Each build's gold alt (Iron Axe +4, Javelin +2, Iron Spear +4, Phantom Ring, Healing Staff)

decisions.pick: 1 Bonaventure Salamander +3 · 2 Tobias Zalmoxis +3 · 3 Nuzzuo Da Mina Bow +3 · 4–5 Theodora, Ninae Bronze Spear +3 · 6 Guzran, 7 Dietrich Da Mina Sword +3 · 8–9 Centurio, Buccar Shielding Axe +3
decisions.why: One level each, Breza's deploy first: Salamander Mt 3→15, Zalmoxis on Boon kills, Crit +10 on Nuzzuo's flier shots, the Bronze Spear +3 jump. Without stones Iron/Bronze stop at +2: Da Mina +2 (Mt 20) is every other main.
decisions.alt: Iron +4 mains everywhere (two stones each, Mt +1 over Da Mina +2)
